h2. Description

*In Tech View the status pill should be the same height at Compact and Regular and taller at Comfortable.* On staging it is the same height at all three.

For example,
* the rows get shorter at Compact and taller at Comfortable, so the density does change
* the status pill stays the same height at all three densities

This appears inconsistent with the requirement defined in *Epic SV-10043* (Story *SV-10049*), the PRD and the design.

h2. Steps to Reproduce

# Sign in to staging as an Admin, check the top bar shows *Staging Heavy Duty - 9919*, and use a browser window 1440 px wide at 100% zoom.
# Open *Work Orders*, click the *All* tab, then *Tech View* in the display switcher (right side of the toolbar).
# Click the density button and choose *Compact*, then *Regular*, then *Comfortable*, looking at the status pills each time.
#* The pill is the same height at all three.

*Actual Result:*
* The status pill is the same height at Comfortable as at Regular.

*Expected Result:*
* The pill is taller at Comfortable, as the test expects: *"Step 12: at Comfortable the pills are visibly taller than at Regular (22 px in the PRD), as in the Comfortable picture."*
